payload.findingText:
RV-001 [implementer] todo-cli:ASM-012.assumption: 'positional arguments beyond the ones the Contract of the invoked command defines are ignored: `todo done 1 2` marks task 1 done and leaves task 2 open, and `todo list foo` behaves as `todo list`' (todo-cli:CTR-002.error_taxonomy: 'exit 2 - E_USAGE_UNKNOWN_OPTION: a token other than --all beginning with -- is given'); src/args/index.ts:27-29 answers `todo done 1 2` with E_USAGE_UNKNOWN_OPTION `usage: unknown argument 2` and src/args/index.ts:46 answers `todo list foo` with E_USAGE_UNKNOWN_OPTION `usage: unknown argument foo`, both exiting 2 — behaviour no record in this task names, and the opposite of ASM-012.
RV-002 [implementer] todo-cli:ASM-005.assumption: 'an id argument is valid only when it consists of decimal digits and its value is at least 1, and the token is echoed exactly as given' (todo-cli:OQ-005 option A consequence: '`todo done 007` prints `#007 done`'); src/args/index.ts:11 `/^[1-9][0-9]*$/` with src/args/index.ts:24-25 answers the decimal-digit token `007` (value 7) with E_USAGE_INVALID_ID `usage: invalid id 007` and exit 2.
RV-003 [implementer] todo-cli:CTR-005.exit_code_on_success: 0 for the command form `todo --help` (todo-cli:BEH-020.then: 'exit 0; stdout holds the usage text') and design/tech.md M-03 `ParsedCommand`: `{ readonly command: "help" }`; src/args/index.ts:65-66 sends the first token `--help` to the default branch and returns E_USAGE_UNKNOWN_OPTION `usage: unknown argument --help`, so the `help` variant of the M-03 return type is unreachable.
